Two Giant Pandas Arrive in Atlanta from China

Two giant pandas have arrived at Zoo Atlanta from China for a 10-year stay. The pandas' arrival was noted in coverage that also mentioned lawsuits related to BioLab and a shooting in Macon. One report linked the pandas' arrival to a summit between Trump and Xi.
